flakeRef: path:. (recorded with cwd = the scenario directory under tests/; flake.lock is not created, fixtures have no inputs)

commands.json: cd tests/{scenario} && nix flake show --json --legacy --all-systems path:. > show.json 2> /tmp/fsn-record-{scenario}.json.stderr; echo $?  # record as "exits.json"
commands.text: cd tests/{scenario} && nix flake show --legacy --all-systems path:. > show.txt 2> /tmp/fsn-record-{scenario}.stderr; echo $?  # record as "exits.text" (only app-leaves keeps show.txt as golden)

app-leaves.notes: apps.x86_64-linux.withDesc carries meta.description; noDesc has none (show JSON leaf is {"type":"app"}, text 'app: no description'); defaultApp.x86_64-linux is an app leaf with description. fsn must emit description or null.

baseline-tree.notes: emptyTop -> show {"type":"unknown"}; empty apps/nixosConfigurations/outputs pruned entirely; legacyPackages.x86_64-linux.nested.set.a is deeper than show's white-list (show emits nested:{}); packages.hello is a derivation; packages.aarch64-linux is an empty set pruned by show.

config-leaves.notes: Non-empty config namespaces: nixosConfigurations.host1 -> show {"type":"nixos-configuration"} (aligned, golden mode); homeConfigurations is an fsn extension namespace and show emits {"type":"unknown"} without recursing, so homeConfigurations.user1 is covered by the EXT_ROOTS exemption. fsn must render both host/user as kind:'config' with configType nixos/home-manager (walker stops at depth 2 for these namespaces).

eval-errors.notes: packages.x86_64-linux.broken = throw => nix flake show ABORTS with exit 1 (throw/assert is not caught by show); no static golden is kept (show.json was empty). fsn must exit 0 and mark the leaf kind:'error' while still rendering the sibling derivation.

git-dirty-root-line.notes: LIVE comparison only, no static golden: the fixture is copied to a temp dir which is then made a dirty git worktree (git init; empty commit; `git add -N flake.nix`), so the lockedRef/root line is `git+file://<tmp>` (random path, not recordable). tests/integration.rs captures live `nix flake show --legacy --all-systems` (text) and `--json --legacy --all-systems` in the same worktree before running fsn.

commands.setup: cp -R tests/git-dirty-root-line <tmp> && git init -q && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -q --allow-empty -m init && git add -N flake.nix

ifd-denied.notes: packages.x86_64-linux.ifd is builtins.readFile (derivation ...) i.e. IFD. show exits 0 and emits {} for the leaf; text says 'omitted due to use of import from derivation'. fsn must FAIL by default (IFD disabled) with a non-empty, IFD-mentioning stderr. No static golden is kept (show.json is degenerate).

non-derivation-leaves.notes: all three leaves (packages/checks/devShells.<sys>.<name> = { name = ...; }) are not derivations: show warns '<attrpath>.name is not a derivation' and omits the leaf, leaving {} in show.json. fsn renders the attrset and its string children (extension).

template-leaves.notes: templates.noDesc has no description => upstream nix flake show ABORTS with exit 1 (error: attribute 'templates.noDesc.description' does not exist); no static golden is kept (show.json was empty). fsn extends the semantics and must render noDesc with description:null (integration.rs uses hardcoded expectations).

part-selection.notes: Text-mode part selection: `-p packages.x86_64-linux -p packages -p packages.x86_64-linux` reports two swallow notices (the descendant covered by its ancestor, in resolution order) and renders only the packages subtree; apps.x86_64-linux is not rendered. fsn.txt is the recorded stdout (line 1, the root line, embeds the temp path and is skipped; the body is compared byte-for-byte) and fsn.stderr the recorded notice bytes, compared exactly. A second run with the same parts in JSON mode carries the M1 node assertions.

part-unknown.notes: Two rows share this fixture. part-unknown-candidates: `-p nope.x`, whose failAt is the flake-outputs attrset, so stderr pins the complete sibling candidate list and its order (`apps, checks, packages`). part-unknown-below-leaf: `-p packages.x86_64-linux.hello.name`, a part strictly below a derivation leaf, so stderr pins the empty-candidates branch (`cannot descend past '...' (not an attrset, or an evaluation-failed leaf)`). Both exit 1 with empty stdout; the full stderr bytes are compared exactly.

walker-namespaces.notes: Real walker label coverage (Gate 1 M6 / Gate 2 F5): devShell/devShells -> development-environment; packages/legacyPackages/defaultPackage/formatter -> package; checks (deep) and hydraJobs keep the plain derivation label (absent). Also covers nixosConfigurations/homeConfigurations/darwinConfigurations config leaves (configType nixos/home-manager/darwin), defaultTemplate/templates, and packages/legacyPackages derivations. show.json is the recorded upstream `nix flake show` oracle; the M1 nodes assert every label, description and configType.
